text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be<n>taking on the
Twinkle Series. The<n>Umamusume joining me for
this<n>journey is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hello-lo! I'm Ines Fujin, and here's<n>to our
brand-new partnership!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, I've got a few<n>part-time jobs I
balance. I'll make<n>sure to schedule my shifts
around our<n>training, so don't hold back and whip<n>me
into shape!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna give both racing and work<n>everything
I've got—that's how I'll<n>repay my family for
supporting me!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps<n>towards
competing in the Twinkle<n>Series!
